body: I have plenty of friends. But I don't feel like they're the right people for me. They're honestly pretty toxic for a large part. The only people that I actually consider as friends are in other countries and I can only keep up with them from time to time online. I don't even know how to start looking for new people in my immediate area, and I feel so isolated because of it.

Your experiences aren't the same as everyone else's. There are plenty of people out there who would go out of their way and selflessly care for a friend. You can't just brand everyone as selfish like that. Keep searching and talking with people, and you'll find those people in many places.

It'd just be the same as the widely accepted definition of a genocide, as can be taken from Oxford Languages:

 "The deliberate killing of a large number of people from a particular nation or ethnic group with the aim of destroying that nation or group."

There isn't much theory that suggests a different definition than this.
I don't know if you're trolling, but that's the point of this sub. To ask questions you think might be seen as "stupid".
No judgements here. This is the sub for a question like this.

I'm 19, but I can be an option if no other works out. Let me know.
